text:
Sam: found this on my lunch scroll, felt uncomfortably accurate :joy:
Maya: omg the indentation trauma is real :eyes:
Sam: https://imgur.com/a/fake-meme-link (image: comic of a developer trying to bump semver by changing a single space in a YAML)
Alex: that line 'version: 1.0.0' vs 'version: 1.0.1' but like... with two extra spaces, classic. :exploding_head:
Irene: pro tip: when in doubt, blame the parser and add a newline.
Maya: CI-bot, any objections to deploying the 'yaml-sass' branch?
CI-bot: sam/tests failed on lint: yaml indentation error at config/services.yml:12
Sam: ahaha of course it fails. I literally moved a tab to a new column like a rebellious teenager.
Alex: quick poll: is semver a guideline or a superstition? :thinking_face:
Maya: superstition with good commit messages.
Irene: guideline if you're lucky, religion if you're on frontend.
Sam: code snippet for future archaeologists:
```yaml
service:
  name: beverage-dispenser
  version: "1.0.0"  # changed to 1.0.1 -> whole world collapsed
  settings:
    cold: yes
    syrup: 3
```
Maya: the comment alone tells a saga. :book:
Alex: reaction chain: :coffee: :sweat_smile: :bug:
Sam: also adding "semver-therapy" to next Friday's watercooler topics. who'd join?
Maya: count me in. I have receipts (aka broken pipelines).
Irene: same. I'll bring stickers that read 'I survived one YAML merge'.
Alex: can we make them semver-compliant stickers? like v1.0.0_sticker?
Sam: lol only if the font supports monospace and tragic indentation
Maya: ok I'm saving this thread for posterity. tag me if someone actually writes a plugin that auto-bumps semver with proper whitespace handling.
CI-bot: noted: creating issue #4242 'automatic semver-whitespace harmonizer'
Sam: :clap: perfect, now the real work begins — fixing the accidental tab I introduced 3 hours ago.
Irene: moral of the story: never sed -i on config while caffeinated. :coffee:
Alex: amen to that.
Maya: good chat, back to real work (or more memes). :party_popper:
